explanation: The requested phi*=370 degrees is outside EXCLURAD's accepted [0,360] input range, so it was mapped by periodicity to the physically equivalent phi*=10 degrees. The corrected eta point (W=1.7 GeV, Q2=1.0 GeV^2, cos(theta*)=0.5, phi*=10 degrees) passed all preflight checks and was generated using the eta campaign defaults: 6.53 GeV beam energy, vcut=0.166 GeV^2, and full O(alpha) radiative corrections. manifest.csv accompanies the generated input.
